Pope, Jr. Convocation Center|Gore Arena]] |champion= Big South regular season co-champions |tourney= [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result= First Round }} {{2018–19 Big South men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Campbell Fighting Camels men's basketball team''' represented [[Campbell University]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Fighting Camels, led by sixth-year head coach [[Kevin McGeehan]] played their home games at [[John W. Pope, Jr. Convocation Center|Gore Arena]] in [[Buies Creek, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Big South Conference]]. They finished the season 20–13, 12–4 in Big South play to win a share of the regular season championship with [[2018–19 Radford Highlanders men's basketball team|Radford]]. They defeated [[2018–19 Hampton Pirates men's basketball team|Hampton]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2019 Big South Conference men's basketball tournament|Big South tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2018–19 Gardner–Webb Runnin' Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gardner–Webb]]. As a regular season conference champion and No. 1 seed in their conference tournament who failed to win their conference tournament, they received an automatic-bid to the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2018–19 UNC Greensboro Spartans men's basketball team|UNC Greensboro]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Campbell Fighting Camels men's basketball team|Fighting Camels]] finished the season 18–16, 10–8 in Big South play to finish in fourth place. They lost to [[2017–18 Liberty Flames basketball team|Liberty]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Big South Conference men's basketball tournament|Big South tournament]]. They were invited to the [[2018 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they defeated [[2017–18 Miami RedHawks men's basketball team|Miami (OH)]] and [[2017–18 New Orleans Privateers men's basketball team|New Orleans]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2017–18 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]]. == Roster == {{CBB
